changelog:
Convene skill initial release.

- Launches the Trading Legends Council: 10 legendary trader personas each vote independently on a symbol and timeframe.
- Aggregates all ballots into a unified verdict (LONG, SHORT, or NO_TRADE) via a deterministic Chairman process.
- Automated first-run configuration for MT5 (zero-config when possible) and optional TradingView support.
- Ensures all data is fetched and processed using only project-supplied tools and environments—prevents sourcing or fabricating market data from elsewhere.
- Detailed setup and error handling to provide a consistent and robust analysis experience across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
